source_text: In empirical analyses separating procedure-specific effects from social factors, FGC status itself showed no significant independent association with physical health morbidities, including genitourinary difficulties or pain during intercourse (OR=0.79 for poor physical health), whereas experiences of discrimination strongly predicted adverse outcomes (OR=2.68).
